name: 01-pages
notes: Question pages and comment reads; returned empty comments are legitimate.

name: 02-discovery
notes: Global directory sorts can still scan; selected ID is unused, so no parameter mapping is needed.

name: 03-users
notes: Existing post owners improve useful user-post/profile reads; this biases toward active authors.

name: 04-catalog
notes: Tag tokens come from the selected questions; history is naturally empty on unedited imported posts.

name: 05-counters
notes: Successful independent counter increments and access updates.

name: 06-votes
notes: State-aware single-operation calls; a fresh run needs no preceding voting run. Repeated actors alternate removal/insertion. Concurrent duplicates may legitimately return NoChange/Conflict.

name: 07-content
notes: If a cached answer target has closed, comment instead; closure after the check can still race. Refresh pools between bounded runs. Text varies per invocation.

name: 08-edits
notes: Replaces content/profile fields. Retags alternate two valid sets; concurrent calls may race into NoChange.

name: 09-maintenance
notes: Existing parent/answer/owner tuples; actions adapt to live state, with ordinary races left visible.

name: 10-registration
notes: Independent creation; returned ID need not feed any other group.

name: 11-hot-counters
notes: Eight stable targets per run; increase threads for ordinary contention. Hot within a sampled window, not a claim of global popularity.

name: 12-expensive
notes: 3% invocation budget taken from original discovery (2%) and catalog (1%). Body/tag/related/leaderboard/badge work can dominate resources. Dates surround actual snapshot content.

name: 13-comment-maintenance
notes: Depleting targets: run no more total calls than returned parameter rows, then reload. Do not loop stale deleted comments.
